_comment: Cash in the Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund, from the Ministry of Finance nine-bank table as compiled on the Rasuwa flood bulletin donate page. The bulletin is someone else's aggregation; the government statement is the source. These are reviewed content. Two rules: (1) the pre-disaster balance is already inside the 6.55 billion — never add it again; (2) foreign pledges, in-kind cargo and the IFRC DREF are not this fund and are never added to it. lib/flood.ts re-adds the bank rows at load.
as_of_label_en: 12 Bhadau (Ministry of Finance / PM Disaster Relief Fund)
as_of_label_ne: १२ भदौ (अर्थ मन्त्रालय / प्रधानमन्त्री दैवी प्रकोप उद्धार कोष)

headline.label_en: In the PM Disaster Relief Fund
Already in the fund before the flood

breakdowns.caption_en: Nine banks, 12 Bhadau. Rs 6.55 billion = 4.38 billion collected after the flood plus 2.17 billion already held. The USD line is a separate label.
breakdowns.caption_ne: नौ बैंक, १२ भदौ। रु. ६ अर्ब ५५ करोड = विपद्पछि ४ अर्ब ३८ करोड + मौज्दात २ अर्ब १७ करोड। डलर छुट्टै लेबल हो।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The 2.17 billion already in the fund is inside the 6.55 billion, not on top of it. USD 680,618 is not part of the Nepali-rupee total. Foreign pledges, World Bank Rs 25 billion and the IFRC appeal are not this fund.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: विपद्अघिको २ अर्ब १७ करोड ६ अर्ब ५५ करोडभित्र छ, माथि होइन। डलर ६,८०,६१८ नेपाली जम्मामा होइन। वैदेशिक घोषणा, विश्व बैंक २५ अर्ब र आईएफआरसी अपिल यो कोष होइनन्।

breakdowns.caption_en: UK $6.79m + US $3.6m + OCHA $3.2m + South Korea $1m + ADB $5m. These are pledges, not cash in the Prime Minister's fund.
breakdowns.caption_ne: बेलायत $६.७९ मि. + अमेरिका $३.६ मि. + ओसीएचए $३.२ मि. + दक्षिण कोरिया $१ मि. + एडीबी $५ मि.। घोषणा हुन्, प्रधानमन्त्री कोषमा आएको नगद होइनन्।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: Not added to the Rs 6.55 billion. World Bank Rs 25 billion and the IFRC CHF 25 million appeal are separate lines, not inside this $19.59 million. ADB $5m is a pledge, not cash received.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: रु. ६ अर्ब ५५ करोडमा जोडिँदैन। विश्व बैंक २५ अर्ब र आईएफआरसी CHF २५ मिलियन अपिल यो $१९.५९ मिलियनभित्र होइनन्। एडीबी $५ मिलियन घोषणा हो, आएको नगद होइन।

exclusive.detail_en: Rs 25 billion. Not cash in the Prime Minister's fund.
exclusive.detail_ne: रु. २५ अर्ब। प्रधानमन्त्री कोषमा आएको नगद होइन।

exclusive.label_en: IFRC DREF to Nepal Red Cross
exclusive.detail_en: Emergency fund for the Red Cross. Not the Prime Minister's accounts.
exclusive.detail_ne: नेपाल रेडक्रसलाई आपत्कालीन कोष। सरकारको खातामा आएको होइन।

exclusive.detail_en: 10 tonnes then 37.5 tonnes. In-kind, not cash. Transfer at Tribhuvan not confirmed.
exclusive.detail_ne: १० टन त्यसपछि ३७.५ टन। सामग्री, नगद होइन। त्रिभुवन हस्तान्तरण पुष्टि छैन।
